content_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA256 of RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 bytes for {"prepared": PreparedBinding, "protocol": scientific descriptor}, without a trailing newline. Includes the complete prepared binding; excludes request_id and protocol_id. No defaults are inserted before hashing.

RuntimeBudget.description: Last durable owner-thread running duration; excludes pause, preparation and finalization. Unknown retains the last confirmed lower bound (or null for legacy). No wall-age estimate or automatic recovery.

OutputFinalization.description: Output-only state after confirmed engine exit. Scientific terminal state, running duration and control receipts remain unchanged if finalization fails. Complete means local sealed artifacts, never OSS publication. Null total fields occur together only when pre-seal output failure leaves inventory unknown; processed fields remain zero. Numeric totals describe sealed engine outputs; complete adds one generated result manifest, so artifact_ids length equals total_files + 1.

FinalizedArtifactPage.description: A bounded page from one exact completed finalization; historical checkpoint descriptors are excluded. Cursor is a member of its immutable sorted artifact_ids. Missing or mismatched descriptors fail closed.
